The VIX at 21.45 combined with transitioning vol regime suggests heightened uncertainty and potential for sharp moves in either direction. Five new large flow trades during this cycle likely represent institutional positioning ahead of expected volatility. The CAG reading of 1.74 (BULL-DELUDED) suggests excessive bullish sentiment that could reverse quickly in a negative gamma environment.
